subject: website
name: Intents Engine
summary: Nani's Intents Engine, a natural-language swap and send page. It stays at Level 2: when it opens it loads ethers 5.7.2 from cdnjs.cloudflare.com without an integrity hash, so the CDN could change the code that runs on the page. It also loads images from GitHub and ENS.
